title: Witch in Electric Orb
description: A silhouetted witch in a pointed hat stands inside a large transparent spherical orb, one hand raised as purple and cyan lightning bolts emanate from her fingers. The orb contains a glowing pink moon, a gnarled black tree, and a field of vibrant red and pink flowers at the base.
prompt: A silhouetted witch wearing a pointed hat stands inside a large transparent bubble floating in space. She raises one hand releasing vibrant purple and cyan magical lightning that cracks across the interior. Behind her is a large glowing hot pink full moon and a dark gnarled leafless tree. The base of the orb is covered in bright red and pink glowing flowers. Dramatic fantasy scene with magical energy, stars in the background.
